raw_response:
The issuer shows adequate liquidity (current ratio 1.22) and solid ongoing profitability (EBIT about 10.5% of revenue), with substantial retained earnings supporting financial flexibility. However, leverage is fairly high, with liabilities at roughly 78% of assets and equity only about 22% of assets, which keeps the profile in the lower-to-mid investment-grade range rather than the high-grade category.

DECISION: BBB
